params.body:
Restack of #360 (`workbench/fix/mail-logo-and-address-3`) on the one-file-per-finding layout. **Merge order: #368, #369, #370 (the layout), #374, #376, #379, then this one.** #360 carried the relation picker (#358) along; here that part lives in #376 below, and this PR holds only the mail and address change. The gateway pushes each PR as a snapshot of its own files on top of main, so this diff shows only this PR's files.

Same change as #360, with one difference: the finding it added as X-130 is a file in `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/`: `2026-09-15-mail-logo-zonder-maat-en-geplakt-adres.md` (opgelost). `CustomAddressTest`, `MailDealerBlockTest` and `MailPreview` refer to it by slug. **Rules renumbered: R P1-2.17 (address composed) becomes R P1-2.18 and R P1-2.18 (image size in mail) becomes R P1-2.19**, because main took P1-2.17 for the worklists on a phone (#371) after #360 was written; the `@rule` tags in `CustomAddressTest` and `MailDealerBlockTest` and the reference in R S4-8.13 follow. R S4-8.13 is new and free on main.

Checked locally on top of the stack: `RulesIdentityTest`, `RulesDocsBuildTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `MailDealerBlockTest`, `CustomAddressTest`, `RelationPickerTest` plus `WorklistPageTest` (33 tests, 139 assertions, OK). Shane closes the original.
params.title: Mail: the dealer logo has a size and the address is composed (restacked)
